title: Cadar Sarung
subject: a couple trying to put a fitted sheet on a bed on Saturday morning, fighting over which corner is which and finally meeting in the middle of the mattress
caption: Malay 1970s Afrobeat, long polyrhythmic groove with a tight horn section. Two clean interlocking electric guitars playing repeating figures, electric bass locked on a one-bar riff, tenor sax and trumpet stabbing and answering the vocal, congas and shekere layering the rhythm, drum kit on a driving open hi-hat. Dry live band sound, light tape saturation. Female alto, bright relaxed mid register, playful conversational sung delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, G minor. Upbeat, funny, affectionate mood. No synth lead, no drum machine, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drops.
lyrics:
[Intro - guitars, congas, bass riff]
[Verse 1]
Pagi Sabtu, cadar baru dari bungkusan
Kau pegang hujung kiri, aku hujung kanan
Empat penjuru, empat pendapat, satu katil
Getah tak muat, kita tarik dari dua arah
[Pre-Chorus]
Kau kata, "Yang ini atas", aku kata, "Bawah"
Cadar sangkut pada dahi kita
[Chorus]
Cadar sarung, cadar sarung
Satu penjuru lagi, sabar sikit
Cadar sarung, cadar sarung
Kita jumpa di tengah tilam
[Verse 2]
Kau lompat atas katil, aku lompat sama
Hujung merah naik, hujung biru turun
Bantal jatuh, kucing pun lari
Aku ketawa, kau ketawa, cadar melorot
[Pre-Chorus]
Kau kata, "Sudahlah, tidur atas lantai"
Aku kata, "Tak boleh, cadar tu hadiah"
[Chorus]
Cadar sarung, cadar sarung
Penjuru ketiga masuk, hampir menang
Cadar sarung, cadar sarung
Kita jumpa di tengah tilam
[Bridge - horns, congas]
Tangan kau pegang tangan aku, bukan hujung cadar
Empat penjuru, dua orang sahaja
[Chorus]
Cadar sarung, cadar sarung
Penjuru keempat, bunyi klik, kita menang
Cadar sarung, cadar sarung
Kita baring di tengah tilam
[Outro - horns, guitars, congas]
